crossRefs.note: Abimelech rose up, and all the people who were with him, by night, and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies.

people.name: Abimelech
people.line: Son of Gideon, self-proclaimed king of Shechem

people.name: Shechem
people.line: City in Canaan, later allotted to Ephraim

translations.web: Abimelech rose up, and all the people who were with him, by night, and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies.
translations.bsb: So Abimelech and all his troops set out by night and lay in wait against Shechem in four companies.
translations.kjv: And Abimelech rose up, and all the people that were with him, by night, and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies.
translations.asv: And Abimelech rose up, and all the people that were with him, by night, and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies.
